items.title: Alex Bigard Interview, 1960-04-30
items.q: What happened after you left De Conge's orchestra?

ctx.x: Oh Man Bernard. Oh M-E-R. Oh Man Bernard.
Oh, back to De Conge. What happened after you left De Conge's orchestra?

Those brothers? Well Pete, he went to, uh, Pete's supposed to be in Europe right now. And Albert, it was the last time I heard he was at St. Louis. But I heard he had given up playing music. He was a policeman up there. And Adolf Rooney got killed in an automobile accident. Come from playing.
